title: Header Dependency Closure
prompt: Given the edge table already in your editor (`struct dep { int obj; int header; }; deps[]` mapping objects to the headers they include: main.o→util.h, util.o→util.h, main.o→main.h), implement `int header_touch_breaks(size_t n_objects, const int *obj_uses_header, size_t n_uses)` returning how many objects must rebuild when a header changes — obj_uses_header being a 0/1 per object. Then implement `int stale_objects_possible(int rule_includes_header)` returning 1 iff omitting a real header dependency can leave stale objects after an edit.

tests.name: affected objects rebuild
tests.hint: Two of the three objects include the changed header: two rebuilds.

tests.name: omission leaves stale objects
tests.hint: A rule that forgets a header dependency lets edited headers ship as stale objects — the quiet lie of incomplete graphs.
